admissionInfo.note: Application for admission to the graduate program with application fee by the established deadline.
admissionInfo.text: 1. Application for admission to the graduate program with application fee by the established deadline. 2. Submit official transcripts from all universities attended. 3. A bachelor’s degree from a regionally accredited college/university or the international equivalent. 4. A 3.0 cumulative undergraduate GPA or a 3.0 GPA calculated on the last 60 semester hours (90 quarter hours) or undergraduate work. 5. Letter of recommendation from supervising administrator. 6. International applicants whose native language is not English must have a TOEFL score of 79 iBT or higher, or an IELTS band score of 6.0 or higher within the past two years. 7. International students must also meet all US government requirements for international students. 8. Interview with graduate program committee. 9. The university uses a selective admissions process for admitting students to graduate programs. Meeting minimum admissions criteria does not guarantee admission to the graduate program or to the University as a graduate student.
